mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, u.login_id AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, a.achievement_status, d.performance_content AS achievement_content, d.academic_year, d.semester_code::integer AS semester, a.attachment_ref
FROM education_achievements a JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND CURRENT_DATE >= m.effective_start_date AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR CURRENT_DATE <= m.effective_end_date) ORDER BY m.organization_code

SELECT p.evaluation_year FROM input_period_settings p WHERE p.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND p.active_yn = 'Y' AND (p.organization_code IS NULL OR p.organization_code = #{organizationCode}) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN p.start_at AND p.end_at ORDER BY p.setting_id

SELECT m.management_item_code, m.management_item_name, m.required_yn, m.data_type, m.teacher_editable_yn, e.evaluation_year FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id WHERE a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND m.active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY e.evaluation_year DESC, m.sort_order, m.management_item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lecture_improvement_achievement_details ( achievement_id, performance_content, academic_year, semester_code ) VALUES (#{id}, #{body.achievementContent}, #{body.academicYear}, CAST(#{body.semester} AS varchar))
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = TRIM(#{body.managementItemCode}), achievement_date = #{body.achievementDate}, attachment_ref = #{attachments}, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N'

UPDATE lecture_improvement_achievement_details SET performance_content = #{body.achievementContent}, academic_year = #{body.academicYear}, semester_code = CAST(#{body.semester} AS varchar) WHERE achievement_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, opinion, processed_by, request_id ) VALUES ('LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT', #{id}, NULL, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', '강의개선 최초 입력', #{userId}, #{requestId})
